protocol: Frozen pixel-only model; independent photograph identities; no fitting, threshold selection, or feature changes from evaluation data.

second_bus.bbox_scope: Loose manually supplied evaluation rectangle, not segmentation. A mark inside its background pixels is not proven correct.

known_roi_probe.scope: Supplied bbox crop rescaled and letterboxed; no background removal; recognition probe with known ROI, not localization.

scope: One independent street plus one independent bus photograph. Compositing tests seen foreground identity on unseen background. Second-photo bbox is coarse. No population photographic accuracy claim.
